```plato

    // The quadrilateral Doo-Sabin emits along one undirected edge, named by its
    // lower corner. With the corner running u to v in the near face, its twin runs
    // v to u in the far face, and the ribbon between the two shrunken faces reads
    // counter-clockwise from OUTSIDE as: far-at-u, far-at-v, near-at-v, near-at-u.
    // Taking the near face first instead traces the same quadrilateral backwards
    // and inverts the result's normals.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.
    DooSabinEdgeFace(nextCorners: Array<CornerIndex>, twins: Array<CornerIndex>, corner: Integer): Array<VertexIndex>
        => [VertexIndex(nextCorners[twins[corner].Value].Value),
            VertexIndex(twins[corner].Value),
            VertexIndex(nextCorners[corner].Value),
            VertexIndex(corner)];
```
